fields.q: 到底怎样才算长大成人啊？好像每个人都得跨过一道坎才行。
fields.en: How do you become an adult, anyway? It seems like everyone has to overcome a challenge to do it.

fields.q: 你觉得我的枪术有一天能超过我爸吗？
fields.en: Do you think I'll ever be better with a spear than my dad?

fields.q: 有时候别人好像一眼就能猜到我在想什么。我就那么好懂吗？

fields.en: I can't stand cowardice. But I guess maybe that's better than getting used to it.
fields.name: 凯伊
